literal_meaning: ঘরের খেয়ে বনের মোষ তাড়ানো (eating from one's own home while chasing the buffalo of the forest)
figurative_meaning_en: Taking on someone else's responsibilities without any reason
similar_in_english: Biting off more than you can chew
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ঘরের খেয়ে বনের মোষ তাড়ানোর মতো প্রতিবেশীর ব্যবসায় হস্তক্ষেপ করছে।
এই অভ্যাস ছাড়ো, না হলে ঘরের খেয়ে বনের মোষ তাড়ানোর ফলে কষ্ট পাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He's taking on his neighbor's business issues unnecessarily, just like eating from home but chasing the forest buffalo.
Stop meddling in others' affairs, or you'll end up suffering from taking on the forest buffalo while fed at home.
note: This idiom draws from traditional rural Bengali agrarian life involving livestock management.
